name: Power converter / inverter
summary: An identified interface converting electrical power between documented circuit forms.
description: A power converter changes electrical power between the circuit forms specified for its application. In a battery energy storage system, a power conversion system commonly provides the interface between DC storage and an AC system. Direction of power flow and operating capabilities are product-specific.

The drawing should label the AC and DC interfaces and identify switching, protection and controls separately. A generic converter box does not establish grid-forming, grid-following, island operation or export capability. Those behaviours require the selected product and system documentation.
readingNotes: Read the AC/DC interface labels before following power flow.
Identify the selected operating capabilities from the product and system documentation.
drawingChecklist: Reference the selected converter and control equipment.
distinction: Inverter, converter and PCS can denote different equipment boundaries. Define what is included in the represented assembly.
